s: Look at the picture. What did the man forget to prepare?【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 從圖片中可清楚看出桌上有　bread（麵包）、chicken legs（雞腿）和　tomatoes（番茄），故選(Ｃ)　Lettuce（萵苣）。

s: Alice really likes having noodles for breakfast, 　　　?【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 直述句為現在簡單式一般動詞單數的肯定語態，所以附加問句應該採用否定的現在簡單式單數助動詞，故選(Ａ)　doesn’t she。

s: Mr. Hu speaks good English 　　　 he lived in the U.S. for many years.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 後句表達前句「Mr. Hu　英語說的很流利」的原因，故選(Ａ)　because（因為）來連接前後句的因果關係。

s: Reese likes to sleep with music on, so she usually turns on the 　　　 before she goes to bed.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為前句有提示詞「聽著音樂睡覺」，所以推知是打開　radio（收音機）。

s: Although the rich woman has everything, she still feels 　　　 with her life and wants to try something new.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由前句的提示詞　although（雖然），可推知語氣有轉折，並且從後句的敘述「想嘗試新事物」，得知應選負面形容詞　bored（無聊的）。

s: Every time Grandpa forgets where he puts his cellphone in the house, he always calls his own number with my cellphone to 　　　 it.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為前句敘述「忘了把手機放在哪裡」，所以推知是要找出手機，故選(Ｂ)　find（找）。

s: Gina worked late and was worried she might not be able to catch the bus.  　　　, she saw a bus coming just after she arrived at the bus station.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為後句說明「就在她抵達公車站時，她看到一輛公車開過來」，所以推知是很幸運地（luckily）。

s: My daughter is much 　　　 now.  The pants she wore last year are already too short for her.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由後句的敘述「褲子已經太短」，可推知是指現在身高高了許多　much taller，選項(Ａ)　higher（更高的），是用來修飾事物的形容詞。

s: I usually carry a camera on my trips; taking pictures 　　　 a good way for me to remember the experience.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 後句的主詞為動名詞　taking，動名詞當主詞時，視為第三人稱單數，故　be　動詞選用　is。

s: When I entered the house for the first time, I found 　　　 was a big round table in the living room.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 後句的句意為「我發現客廳中有一張大圓桌」，表達「某地有…」需要用存在有　there is / are　的句型。

s: The noise those boys are making is giving me a(n) 　　　.  Can you do anything about it?【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由於說明是噪音，又希望對方去處理，所以推知是個負面問題，故選(Ｄ)　headache（頭痛）。

s: After a big party, it took me 　　　 time to clean the apartment.  I’m tired now.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由後句　I’m tired now.（我現在累了），可推知有花了一些時間打掃，故選(Ｄ)　some（一些）。

s: Gary is the best teacher I’ve ever known.  No one 　　　 teaches so well.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由前句說明的「Gary　是我認識的老師中教得最好的」，可推知沒有其他的人教得這麼好，故選(Ｃ)　else（其他的）。

s: Most of the 　　　 along this road were knocked down during the typhoon.  So make sure no cars are coming when you cross the street.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 後句提到「過馬路時，要確定沒有車經過」，所以推知被颱風吹倒的是　traffic lights（交通號誌燈）。

s: My dog, Lucy, was lying on the sofa 　　　 the fan on the wall.  So when the fan fell, she was hit right on the head.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由後句敘述「掉下來正好打到頭」，可以推知　Lucy　當時正躺在電風扇下方，故選(Ａ)　under（下面）。

s:
Bob: Why is the house full of 　　　?
Liz: Oh, no! Looks like it got on fire. I hope everyone in there has run out.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為　Liz　回應說「看起來好像著火了」，所以推知　Bob　應是問「為什麼房子充滿煙霧」，故選(Ｄ)　smoke（煙霧）。

s:
Elise: I need a dress for tomorrow’s party, but I don’t have one.
Fiona: Why don’t you try on my red one? I bought 　　　 last week.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 此句中的代名詞指的是　Fiona　上週買的那件紅洋裝，有限定對象，故用　it　代替。

s:
Mom: Lily, can you help me 　　　?
Lily: Sure. Where’s the brush?【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為　Lily　回應「刷子放在哪裡」，所以推知應是會用到刷子的動作，故選(Ｃ)　paint the door（粉刷門）。

s:
Rose: Who’s that man wearing a white jacket?
Lisa: He’s Dr. Wu’s son.
Rose: Really? They look 　　　 like brothers than father and son.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為有比較級連接詞　than，只能選比較級　less　或　more，又因為　Rose　對「那男人是吳醫生的兒子」感到驚訝，所以推知她認為「他們看起來更像兄弟」，故選(Ｃ)　more（更多的）。

s:
Linda: Jenny, will you still be here this afternoon?
Jenny: Yeah, I think I’ll stay 　　　 five. Then I’ll leave for dinner.【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由　Jenny　後句的說明「然後會離開去吃晚餐」，可以推知她會「待在這裡直到五點」，故選(Ｄ)　until（直到）。

p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 整篇文章是以過去式呈現，所以應選過去進行式。

p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: Doris　是被拉進畫裡的，同時整篇文章的時態是過去式，故採用過去被動式。

p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為整篇文章的時態是過去式，又因為　Doris　不知道那時將會發生何事，所以須採用助動詞　will　的過去式　would，來表達過去未來式。

p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 整篇文章的內容是以過去式時態完成，所以結尾也應採用過去式。

p:
Mr. Lee: Wow! You look great in 　(１)　 glasses! Its glasses are very famous. How much is this pair?
Mr. Kao: Only 500 dollars.
Mr. Lee: Really? Where did you get the glasses?
Mr. Kao: At B. B. Department Store. It's having a sale these days.
Mr. Lee: Does the department store have any 　(２)　 on sale, too? I want to buy a pair for my wife's birthday.
Mr. Kao: Yes, it does. I remember I have the flyer. Here. You'll get a much better price if you buy three pairs at a time.
Mr. Lee: Thanks.

【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為高先生說明眼鏡一副五百元，再對照廣告單上的價錢，所以得知是在商店　NUMA　買的。

p:
Mr. Lee: Wow! You look great in 　(１)　 glasses! Its glasses are very famous. How much is this pair?
Mr. Kao: Only 500 dollars.
Mr. Lee: Really? Where did you get the glasses?
Mr. Kao: At B. B. Department Store. It's having a sale these days.
Mr. Lee: Does the department store have any 　(２)　 on sale, too? I want to buy a pair for my wife's birthday.
Mr. Kao: Yes, it does. I remember I have the flyer. Here. You'll get a much better price if you buy three pairs at a time.
Mr. Lee: Thanks.

【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 因為廣告單上只有商店　Rian's　有三件特惠價的活動，所以得知指的是牛仔褲。

s: (１)Which is NOT said about Carefree Helpline?
p:
Below is an ad of Carefree Helpline.

【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: They listen to people in trouble.
People can talk face to face with them.
They collect money for people in need.
People can call them anytime, any day.
e: 整篇廣告內容並未提及　collect money（募款），所以選項(Ｃ)錯誤。

s: (２)What does your dog turns away mean in the reading?
p:
Below is an ad of Carefree Helpline.

【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: Your dog does not care about you.
Your dog is kicked and runs away.
Your dog cannot find its way home.
e: 第一段中的內容都是敘述親人或朋友的不關心和不在意，所以同一段中的俚語　your dog turns away　也應是相似的語意，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (１)What is Amy trying to tell her father?
o: Mike is the right person for her.
Mike cares a lot about her family.
She feels sorry about breaking her father’s heart.
She thanks her father for what he has done for her.
e: Amy　在信中第二段描述　Mike　為她所做的一切，就是要試著說服她爸爸—　Mike　就是她的理想對象，所以應選(Ａ)。

s: (２)What can we learn about Amy’s father?
o: He has known Mike for over one year.
He will not let Amy leave him so early.
He thinks love means changing for another person.
He is afraid Amy has not thought carefully enough.
e: Amy　的父親在回信中提到，他認為　Amy　還太年輕，而且希望她能多花時間去認識　Mike，所以推知他認為　Amy　考慮的不夠仔細，故選(Ｄ)。

s: (３)What do we know from the reading?
o: Mike is too young for Amy.
Mike does not like a girl who smokes.
Amy thinks she is ready for a new life.
Amy loves Mike the way he used to be.
e: Amy　在信中第一段最後，提到自己已經可以組成一個新家庭，所以推知她認為自己可以開始新生活，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (１)Which is NOT said about dancing?
p:
There are many kinds of dances, but each has its own rules.
When we dance, we follow different rules.
We move to the front or stay in the back.
We dance close together or leave lots of space for each other;
We dance excitedly or slowly to fast or sweet music;
We dance to show how we feel in happy or sad times.
Sometimes we dance with people;
Sometimes we dance solo.
Yes, we dance differently;
But we won’t dance without rules.
　　　
【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: It is done in several ways.
e: 詩歌中並未提及　dancing　是一件困難的事，故選(Ａ)。

s: (２)What do you do when you dance solo?
p:
There are many kinds of dances, but each has its own rules.
When we dance, we follow different rules.
We move to the front or stay in the back.
We dance close together or leave lots of space for each other;
We dance excitedly or slowly to fast or sweet music;
We dance to show how we feel in happy or sad times.
Sometimes we dance with people;
Sometimes we dance solo.
Yes, we dance differently;
But we won’t dance without rules.
　　　
【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: You dance in a public place.
e: 此句與前一句是相反語意的句子，前一句提到「與他人共舞」，所以推知此句是「獨舞」的意思，故選(Ｂ)。

s: (１)Where was Lynn’s watch bought?
p:
: Your new watch looks cool! May I take a look?
　　　　: Sure.
　　　　: Wow! Look at the monkey on the face of it.
　　　　: Monkeys are one of my favorite animals. But the watch shows a different animal every month. Tomorrow is May 1, and it’ll be another kind of animal.
　　　　: That sounds great! I want something like that. Where did you get it?
　　　　: Well, my uncle gave it to me last week. He bought it on a business trip in London.
　　　　: Oh, that’s too bad.
　　　　: Maybe you can go check on the Internet.
【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: In the zoo near her school.
At a gift shop near her house.
e: 對話中　Lynn　提到手錶是她叔叔在倫敦買的，所以應選(Ｂ)一個說英語的城市。

s: (２)What may Lynn’s watch look like on May 1?
p:
: Your new watch looks cool! May I take a look?
　　　　: Sure.
　　　　: Wow! Look at the monkey on the face of it.
　　　　: Monkeys are one of my favorite animals. But the watch shows a different animal every month. Tomorrow is May 1, and it’ll be another kind of animal.
　　　　: That sounds great! I want something like that. Where did you get it?
　　　　: Well, my uncle gave it to me last week. He bought it on a business trip in London.
　　　　: Oh, that’s too bad.
　　　　: Maybe you can go check on the Internet.
【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 對話中　Lynn　提到手錶的錶面每個月都會出現不同的動物，所以應選(Ｃ)。

s: (１)Here are four sentences from the Word Museum. Which is most likely to appear on the next page?
p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: The word silly used to mean‘happy,’ but now it means‘stupid.’
The word terrific used to mean‘terrible,’ but now it means‘excellent.’
The word girl used to mean‘a young person,’ but now it means‘a young woman.’
The word telephone is cut short to phone, but the two words mean the same thing.
e: 網頁資訊中介紹英語字義轉佳的例子，所以是選項(Ｂ)符合文意。

s: (２)What can we learn about the word nice?
p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: It was first used in English around 1100.
It still keeps its old meaning that was used around 1300.
It was used to talk about an important person around 1800.
e: 網頁資訊第二段中說明　1300　年之後的兩百年，也就是　1500　年，nice　開始有「清楚的」的意思，故選(Ａ)。

s: (２)What can we learn about Tea Cottage from this ad?
p:
Below is an ad of a restaurant.

【100　年第　1　次基測】
　ad　廣告
o: They are looking for singers and bands for weekend music shows.
They need cooks who can work both at lunchtime and dinner time.
One who knows about tea-making has a better chance of working there.
The waiters will be paid over USD$60 a day for working during lunchtime.
e: 徵人廣告中服務生的時薪為USD$16，一天工作四或五小時，所以一天薪資是16×4＝64或16×5＝80，都超過60，故選(Ｄ)。

s: (１)What is talked about in the newspaper report?
p:
Lin-hua: Mom, can I put my pet fish into the river?
Mom: No! When you bought it, you told me you’d take care of it, remember?
Lin-hua: But now I want it to live free.
Mom: I think you’re just tired of keeping it. Also, if your pet fish comes from another country, it may bring some problems for the living things in our country after you put it into our river. Haven’t you heard about the fire ants from South America? Since they were brought to Taiwan, they’ve made lots of trouble for the animals and plants here.
Lin-hua: But I read a newspaper report which said that in New Zedland, animals and plants from other countries aren’t always trouble-makers. With these new friends, New Zealand has become a country with many different kinds of animals and plants.
Mom: Well, I just want you to think twice before you do anything. Now, the floor is dirty because of your jumping fish. Please go mop the floor.
【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: Some animals and plants from abroad grow better in New Zealand.
Some animals and plants from New Zealand are very popular in Taiwan.
In Taiwan, some animals and plants from New Zealand do not grow well.
In New Zealand, some animals and plants from abroad do not hurt nature.
e: 對話中的新聞報導內容是「在紐西蘭，來自他國的動植物並非總是麻煩製造者」，也就是在紐西蘭，來自國外的動植物並不會傷害大自然的意思，故選(Ｄ)。

s: (１)What is the reading about?
p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: A new way of cooking rice.
A famous teacher from a small town.
e: 文章中第二段說明這是一個教學計畫，文章最後也提到這計畫很成功，所以選(Ａ)。

s: (２)Which is said in the reading?
p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
o: Farming helps the school make money.
The school bought the land for the farming classes.
It is important for farmers to make good use of land.
e: 文章中第三段提到「學校靠著賣米和對大眾授予種稻課程賺了錢」，故應選(Ｂ)。

s: (３)What is the dream?
p: 【100　年第　1　次基測】
e: 由第三段提到的「有了這些錢，學校可以幫助想出國的學生」和「學生們飛到日本去分享他們特別的種植經驗」，可以推知這個夢想是指造訪國外，故選(Ｃ)。
